en: Black‑and‑white postcard reproduction of an ancient stone relief showing a bearded, helmeted figure in profile holding a goat or ibex over his shoulder. The figure wears a knee‑length garment and substantial boots, rendered in a distinct Near Eastern style. The relief is carved on a roughly rectangular stone slab, with visible cracks and a textured background. No printed caption or writing is visible on the image side.
